name: Monster Girl Academy
source:
In a small school tucked away in the mountains of an island country, the body of a girl is found on a set of abandoned train tracks.

某個島國的深山裡，藏著一所小小的學校。有人在廢棄鐵軌上，發現了一名女孩的屍體。
